tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// ār+yabalokiteshwarānanaikadashīmaṇ+ḍalas+yabidhirgaṅgāyonādīnāmabidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gaṅgā'i chu klung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ye shes spyan ras stong gis sems can khams// gzigs pa mi g.yel thugs rje'i phyag stong gis// gang 'dul thabs kyi sdug bsngal rgyur bcas las// skyob pa'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal// sku gsum bdag nyid thub pa'i dbang po dang*// khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi nas// thun mong theg pas rgyud sbyangs skal ba can// theg chen sngags lam don gnyer 'jug pa'i sgo// spyan ras gzigs dbang dkyil 'khor cho ga'i rim// rgyud gzhung bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin bri// de la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha sum cu rtsa bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas nyams su blang bar bya ba'i tshul la gnyis/ sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor las kyi rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang*/ bsnyen pa dngos so// dang po ni/ dgon pa la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su phyag dar skyang nul legs par byas te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sogs pa dkon mchog gi rten ji ltar rigs par bzhugs su gsol te/ de dag gi spyan sngar mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas bde ba'i stan la skyil krung la sogs pas 'khod de/ 'khor ba la skyo ba'i blo bskyed/ ting nge 'dzin gyi g.yeng ba rnams spangs te/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bsal bar bya'o// de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul mngon sum lta bur dmigs la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes zhe thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba ci nus byas pa'i mthar/

sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dkar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus thams cad khyab pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa la bla ma dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ de rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i bsam pas rdo rje thal mo dang*/ ngag tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta pra ṇa mya na badz+ra ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag bya/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pas+tha nā ya āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ zhes brjod de bdag dbul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta rnams go brjes te so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ slar yang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang bla bre sil snyan la sogs pas kyang mchod par bsam la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bi shiṣ+ṭa pū dza me gha pra sā ra sa mu dra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod de mchod/ de nas yan lag bdun pa bya ste/ sdig pa bshags pa ni/ thog med 'khor ba'i 'gro bar gtogs pa yis// byas pa'i nyes byas ma lus mi bzad 'di// gang zhig phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams na// bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan sngar bshags par bgyi// oṃ sarba pā paṃ sho dha ya da ha na badz+ri swā hā/

dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams// sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa'i phan mdzad dang*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag na gang gnas pa// bsod nams byed pa de la yi rang ngo*// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṇ+ye dzñā na a nu mo da na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ sangs rgyas kun dang byang chub sems dpa' ni// 'gro ba'i skyabs gyur pa la gsol ba ni// phyogs bcu'i sems can ma lus thams cad la// chos kyi sprin las char chen dbab tu gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma pra brta nī pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ so so skye bo pa dang nyes byas rnams// ma lus par ni myur du spangs nas ni// skye med chos kyi sku ni rnam dag par// bzhed pa myur du ldog pa nyid mdzod cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nirbā ṇa me sarba satwā hi tar+thā ya s+thi tir bha wan+tu/ bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ sems can thams cad la ni phan pa'i phyir// bdag gis dge ba gang dag ci bsags pa// skye ba la sogs sdug bsngal thams cad ni// nye bar zhi phyir bdag gis bsngo bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pūṇ+ya nir+yā ta na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sems bskyed pa ni/ skye sogs sdug bsngal rnams kyis nyer gces shing*// mi shes rtog pas nyer bcom bdag nyid can// srog chags rnams la phan phyir byang chub sems// rin chen mchog gyur bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// rtag tu srog chags rnams kyi skyabs dang ni// gnas dang dpung gnyen skyob pa nyid gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pā di taṃ ta thā haṃ sa ma bi ta bodhi tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes don dran bzhin pas tshigs bcad rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ de nas sangs rgyas sras bcas rnams kyis/

rigs kyi bu legs zhes gsungs nas rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sems bskyed kyi gong du gsungs kyang gzhan ltar 'di byas na legs pa go bas/ sems can thams cad bde ba nas/ btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar ngag tu brjod cing don bsam ste bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong par nam mkha'i dbyings ltar spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar bsams la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi stong pa nam mkha'i dbyings ltar spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i steng du yi ge a dkar po 'od du zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zor 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi skur byas/ de rnams tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa sku dang rtsa zhal gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar la 'tsher ba/ g.yas zhal ljang ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ de'i steng zhal dbus ljang gu/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng zhal dbus dmar ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon ljang ba/ zhal thams cad 'dzum bag dang bcas shing spyan rnams dkyus ring ba/ de'i steng du khro zhal mthing nag mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/

dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ de ltar zhal bcu ni pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i ngo bo/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i zhal ban+du dzī ba ka'i me tog ltar dmar ba/ mgrin pa yan chad 'thon pa/ dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ rgyan spangs pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can no// phyag stong gis nye bar mdzes pa'i phyag rnams kyi dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ gsum pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel bar mdzad pa'i mchog sbyin/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas gser gyi pad+ma rtsa ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'o// de'i 'og ma g.yas kyi phyag lhag ma rnams kyi dang pos yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che/ gnyis pas sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pa/ gsum pas me long*/ bzhi pas shel gyi gdu bu/ lnga pas dgra s+t+wa/ drug pas phub/ bdun pas ril ba bhṛṃ ga ra/ brgyad pas rnga yab dkar po/ dgu pas rin po che me shel/ bcu pas rin po che chu shel/ bcu gcig pas skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ bcu gnyis pas rin po che'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcu gsum pas rdo rje/ bcu bzhi pas ral gri/ bco lnga pas lhung bzed/ bcu drug pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ bcu bdun pas rin po che 'dzin pa'o// g.yon pa'i phyag lhag ma rnams kyi dang pos rgun 'brum gyi snod/ gnyis pas pad+ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa/ gsum pas rin po che'i za ma tog bzhi pas rin po che'i ljon shing*/ lnga pas rin po che'i gzhal med khang*/ drug pas dung g.yas su 'khyil ba/ bdun pas 'khar gsil/ brgyad pas rin po cha'i mda'/ dgu pas dril bu/ bcu pas thod pa'i 'khar ba/ bcu gcig pas rin po che'i lcags kyu/ bcu gnyis pas rin po che'i mdung rtse gsum pa/ bcu gsum pas pad+ma le brgan/ bcu bzhi pas sprin rnam pa lnga/

bco lnga pas rin po che'i phyag rgya/ bcu drug pas rin po che'i glegs bam/ bcu bdun pas pad+ma sngon po 'dzin pa'o// de dag las gzhan pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi phyag lhag ma rnams kyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang mar pus mo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba/ phyag thams cad pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing phyag mthil rnams su spyan re mnga' ba/ 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ lha'i rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs pa du mas brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi pañtsa li ka'i ras dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi ska rags dang ldan pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa nag pos nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de nas spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug bya/ spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ mgrin par nyi ma la gnas pa'i pad+ma dmar po āḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsam/ de nas thal mo kha sbyar ba phye ba'i tshul du byas la 'di'i dam tshig snying gar gtugs te/ oṃ pad+mo ud+bha wā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod/ slar yang snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bar bsams la/

dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung*// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ yo ga dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing lha'i nga rgyal brtan por gzung ngo*// de nas sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed nas/ rang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de'i mthar chos 'khor du gzungs kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsams la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ de dag gi thugs ka nas mkhyen rab thugs rje mthu stobs byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang nyid la thim pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya dzñā na sā ga ra/ bai ro tsa na bayū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha te bh+yaḥ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya tha/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭ+ṭe waṭ+ṭe/ tsa le tsa le pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma wa te/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dz+wa la ma sa nā ya swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring nyer gcig sogs bzla/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sid+dh+yan+tu me man+t+ra pa de swā hā/

zhes snying po ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bo// de nas bdag bskyed la bstims pa'i ye shes pa phyung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams la/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar sngags tsam gyis mchod/ bstod pa bsdus pas bstod nas yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ bdag dam tshig pa yang me long la has btab pa bzhin mi dmigs par bsams nas stong pa nyid la gzhag go /ldang ba'i tshe stong pa'i ngang las chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur par bsams te/ bsngo ba smon lam btab nas/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa'i sgo nas gzhan don du 'gyur bar bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis thun bzhi'i rim pas mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'am dus kyi bsnyen pa'am grangs kyi bsnyen pa rnams ji ltar grub par bya'o// bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa 'di bzhin dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi dus sam/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus sam/ rgyun gyi yi dam du byed na'ang rim pa 'di nyid kyi nyams su blang bar bya ba yin no// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor las kyi rim pa la gsum/ sa'i cho ga sta gon gyi cho ga dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o// dang po la bzhi/ sa brtag pa/ sbyang ba/ gzung ba/ bsrung ba'o// dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ grong khyer gyi byang shar gyi phyogs kyi char/ sa gzhi dkar zhing snum pa mtho dma' la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral zhing me tog dang 'bras bus brgyan pa sogs yid dga' ba'i sa btsal lo// gnyis pa ni/

sa de'i bdag po rgyal po sogs la tshig gis bslang*/ ma khugs na rin gyis bslangs nas gnas skabs su dbang bar yod par byas la/ sa der gnas pa'i gzhi bdag sogs la gtor ma byin nas bsrung ba'ang phyag len la mdzad na/ sa'i dbus su gtor ma zhig bsham/ rang kha shar du phyogs pa'i mdun du/ rdo rje dril bu gu gul yungs kar dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa 'dus par byas nas/ skyabs 'gro nas spyan ras gzigs kyi skur ldang ba'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin byas te/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs lan gsum gyis phul la/ mtshams su dril gsil dang bcas te/ sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang*// gang yang sa la brten pa rnams// sems can kun la dge don du// byams pa'i sems kyis gnas par mdzod// lan gsum brjod/ dril bu chig brdung dang*/ zhing skyong gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsal zhing dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar phyin pa'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gsang spyod la blta bar mi dbang ba rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga byed pa la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren gyi rigs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags ring thung brjod cing drag rol bya'o// gu gul gyi bdug

yungs kar gyis phyogs kun du brab cing bskrad/ sa'i lha mo la sa bslang ba ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud sogs su ma bshad pas ma byas kyang chog mod/ rnam snang mngon byang las 'byung ba'i kha bskang nas byed na/ sa'i lha mo bskyed nas gsol ba gdab/ 'og sa'i lha mo sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas nas nam mkhar bteg nas dpang po'i tshul du bzhugs pa'am sa la bstim yang rung gsungs/ gsum pa ni/ de nas gza' skar tshes grangs bzang po la grub na dkyil 'khor bri ba'i bar drag po'i sbyin sreg gis bgegs bzlog zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib zhi bar bya/ ma grub kyang 'gal ba med do// de nas las sngags bzlas shing yungs kar dang chu dang thal bas gtor/ rang spyan ras gzigs kyi nga rgyal gyis gzungs ring ngam snying po bzla zhing sa'i dbus su phyin nas lag pa gnyis sa la bzhag nas/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes nyer gcig sogs brjod/ de nas nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzlas nas rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsams nas sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyong ba'o// de nas gzungs ring bzla bzhin du dkyil 'khor ji tsam byed pa'i sa gzhi dri bzang gi chus byugs te gad dar legs par byas la/ sa gzhi de stong nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du bsgom ste sbyong ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ rang spyan ras gzigs kyi nga rgyal gyis sa'i dbus su 'dug la las sngags brjod cing dri bzang gi chus gtor te/ sa'i phyogs 'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor bris la sems can gyi don rgya chen po bya'o snyam du sems bskyed pa ni blos yongs su bzung ste sa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa sta gon gyi cho ga la gsum/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po ni dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa phyag dar dang skyang nul legs par bya/

bla re dang yol bas brgyan/ dkon mchog gi rten ji ltar 'os pa bzhugs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su thig chen brgyad tsam skya thig tu gdab pa'am/ yang na las thig rdzogs par btab ste/ de yang gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du pad+ma/ rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pa spyi dang 'dra/ rtsa thig nang yan chad cha bzhir bgos la/ phyi ma lha snam gru bzhi pa bya/ de'i nang gi cha gcig la pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug mu khyud dang bcas pa bya/ yang na pad+ma'i tshab tu 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa byas kyang rung*/ de'i nang gi cha chen gcig la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa dang*/ cha nang ma la pad+ma'i lte bar bya'o// de'i dbus su nang du gnas srung gi me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du dbang ldan nas brtsams te mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang*/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga g.yas skor du bsham/ de dag nang du lha so so'i sgos mchod dang*/ dbang ldan du sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu mchod gtor dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun phyogs su gzungs kyi gtor ma dang*/ g.yas phyogs su cha gsum yang bsham/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi shar du shel dkar po dang 'bras dkar po dang*/ me tog dkar po rnams za ma tog la sogs pa'i snod du bzhag de bzhin du lho phyogs su rin po che/ 'bru sna tshogs dang me tog ser po/ nub phyogs su tsan+dan dmar po dang me tog dmar po sna tshogs/ byang du me tog sngon po sna tshogs pa rnams bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khri bzang po'i steng du nī la kaṇ+ṭha'i gzungs bzhugs su gsol/ de dang nye bar mtshan ltas brtag pa'i bum pa shin tu che ba dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ 'bru dang sman gyis gang ba'i za ma tog la sogs pa'i steng du gzhag slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu dang ras la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang po'i steng du dbus su rnam rgyal bum pa dung chos gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa dang*/

phyogs bzhir phrin las bzhi'i bum pa bzhi/ byang shar du las bum ste/ drug po kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa rnams chu srog chags med pas sum gnyis tsam dgang*/ rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ dri lnga/ 'bru lnga/ snying po lnga rnams gzhug ste dgang ngo*// slob ma sta gon byed na de'i yo byad kyang bsham mo// de nas dpon slob rnams gdan la 'khod de mchod pa rnams spyi ltar sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bzla ba'am/ dharma ra ṇi brjod cing rol mos byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te spyan ras gzigs kyi skur ldang ba'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs su bstan pa bzhin bdag bskyed bsgom mo// gnyis pa la bzhi/ sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon no// dang po ni/ sngar gnas bsrung ba'i me tog bsal la/ dkyil 'khor dri'i thig le me tog tshom bu bkod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas dam bca' khas len gyi phyag rgya mdzad cing g.yon pas gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ dar gyi na bza' can rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku phyed yan chad 'thon pa bdag la mngon sum phyogs nas bzhugs par bsams la/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ de nas spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas ngag tu/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// spyod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde// pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ sems can thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa'i phyogs 'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te bsgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len pa dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba 'tshal na/ bdag la las kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gsung bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang*/ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid du thim par bsams te/ mchod gtor dman ma rnams bsal lo// gnyis pa ni/ sa lha'i tshom bu bsal te gtso bo la dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi gnas su zlum po re byas te/ der me tog tshom bu re bkod/ de nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs te/

der srung 'khor gyi nang du gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed cing me tog gi tshom bu rnams lha rnams su bskyed/ mchod pa rgyas par bya ba dang*/ gtor ma dbul ba'i bar 'og mdun bskyed kyi skabs bzhin bya'o// de nas snyan gsan dbab pa'i phyir/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer bsams la/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ngag tu/ spyan ras gzigs dbang bcom ldan 'das// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni brtse bar gyur nas su// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la ni mchod pa'i phyir// sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lags// de ni gnang ba mdzad par rigs// sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang*// byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang*// gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// gang du lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i// sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming*// spyan ras gzigs dbang cher 'byung ba// yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis// cho ga bzhin du 'dri lags na// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa rnams// thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sogs nas dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ sang dngos gzhi'i dus su 'dir byon zhing bdag la dngos grub kyi bka' drin ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod de lhas gnang ba byin par bsam mo// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni sngar bshams pa'i bum pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa rnams yangs shing rgya che ba/

zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma nyis rim dang ldan pa'i phyi ma la pad 'dab bcu drug nang ma la pad 'dab brgyad dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan/ pad+ma nang ma'i byang gi 'dab ma la nyi ma'i gdan/ phyi nang gi 'dab ma gzhan rnams la zla ba'i gdan re re/ de'i phyi rol gyi mtshams bzhi dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re/ phrin las bzhi'i bum par pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ las bum du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor rnams bskyed tshul 'og mdun bskyed dang mtshungs par gsal gdab/ shar gyi bum par hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar la 'tsher ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ lho'i bum par hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad+ma ser po bsnams pa/ nub kyi bum par hrīḥlas 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog margad ltar ljang ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma mchog sbyin dang lcags kyu bsnams pa/ gsum ka'ang pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang lha'i na bzas mdzes pa'o// yang na 'di gsum tshab tu 'phags pa phyag stong spyan stong bskyed kyang chog par gsungs so// byang gi bum par pad zla'i gdan dang seng ge dkar po mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hrīḥlas 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra sku mdog me tog kun+da ltar dkar ba/

ral pa'i thor tshugs can spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang pos pad+ma'i steng na ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas sbrul gyis brgyan pa'i rtse gsum dkar po/ g.yon 'og mas thod pa dkar po dri zhim po can gyi me tog gi tshogs kyis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs can/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ cung zad zur gyis gzigs pa'i rnam pa can/ las bum du pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du bskyed/ 'dir las bum du rigs kyi khro bo'i dbang du byas nas pad+ma mthar byed bskyed na 'brel che mod/ 'on kyang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed pa'ang mi 'gal zhing phyag len las byung ba'o// de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha sum cu so bdun phrin las bzhi'i lha tshogs bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ phyogs dus kun nas skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas/ sogs dang*/ ri bo gru 'dzin legs par brgyan pa nas/ sogs dang*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ nyer spyod kyis mchod de dgug gzhug bya/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ lha thams cad la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ de nas nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/

shar dang lho'i bum pa spyan ras gzigs la/ sems can sdug bsngal me tshogs kyis gdungs pa// thugs rje'i bsil ba'i char gyis tshim mdzad cing*// rab zhi bde ldan gnas su 'dren mdzad pa// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyis sogs sgrol ma dang*/ brtse ba'i thugs rje'i dbang phyug nyid kyi sku// drang srong chen po'i tshul du bstan nas kyang*// 'gro ba'i gdung ba drag po sel mdzad pa// bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas seng ge sgra dang*/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// sogs kyis bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la bstod do// de nas/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros pas gzungs thag la 'khril te song*/ bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul te de dag gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam bskul te/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bum nang gi lha rnams la thim pas/ de dag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas las kyi kha dog dang mthun pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pa bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du 'dres shing bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la/ gzungs ring dang snying po ci nus dang*/ phrin las bzhi'i bum pa'i sngags 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nyer gcig re dang*/ las bum la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams ci nus bzlas te slar yang*/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas te/ bum pa'i lha'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dung chos kyi chu bum pa rnams su blugs te/ dam tshig pa rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum gyis brtan par bya'o// 'dir dung chos rnam rgyal chen po'i tha snyad byas te de'i nang du'ang gtso bo bskyed pa dang*/

dung chos kyi mchod yon phul ba'i gong du las sngags kyi me tog dkar po gsum bum pa rnams su gzhug pa ni gzhan gyi lugs 'phyugs pa yin pas de dag 'dir mi dgos so// las bum gyi lha mi zhu bar cho ga ma tshar bar du brtan bzhugs dang gsol gdab byed pa'ang khungs thub pa'i bshad pa med pas mi bya'o// de nas gtor ma 'og nas 'byung ba ltar btang ngo*// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar kha yar ba rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis chos nyan pa'i kun du spyod pa dang sems bskyed rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa gsal gdab tu bcug la/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rang re rnams kyi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang yon tan dang ldan pa thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa las/ mdzad pa thams cad kyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa ni ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi 'grel pa las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis 'khrud par mi byed la// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal nyid kyi phyag gis sel mi mdzad// rang gi rtogs pa gzhan la 'pho ba mdzad min yang*// chos nyid yang dag bstan nas grol bar mdzad pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang mthun par chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa rnams phyogs ris su bsdu na theg pa chung ngu dang theg pa chen po gnyis su 'du/ theg pa chen po de la dbye na rgyu pha rol du phyin pa'i sde snod dang rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sde snod gnyis las/ 'dir mchog tu gyur pa rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang bya ba so so'i rgyud gnyis las dang po bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi ni bya ba so so'i rgyud du ma tshang ba kha bskang ba dang*/

mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa'i bshad rgyud lta bu ste/ spyod pa bzhi'i don 'dus shing ma tshang ba med pa ston pa dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa smin byed dbang gi bya ba gtso bor ston pa gsang ba spyi rgyud/ sbyor ba'i spyod pa mtshan bcas lha'i rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa legs par grub pa'i rgyud/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud do// bya ba so so'i rgyud la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud/ nor can gyi rigs kyi rgyud/ lngas rtsen gyi rigs kyi rgyud/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi rgyud de drug las/ 'dir pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud do// de la'ang rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po/ rigs kyi yum/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi bka' nyan pho mo'i rgyud de lnga las/ 'dir rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'am/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud do// de la nang gsel gyi dbye ba mang du yod pa las 'dir don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs thogs pa mi mnga' ba dang zhal bcu gcig pa/ nī la kaṇ+ṭha'i gzungs rnams la brten nas dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs dang*/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi la sogs pas legs par bkral ba'i rjes su 'brang ba 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa lha sum cu rtsa bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la sta gon gyi cho ga dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis las/ nub dang po sta gon gyi cho ga ste/ de la bzhi las dang po gsum grub nas/ slob ma sta gon la/ lus kyi bya ba nges 'byung bskyed// gsol gdab ming dbul spro ba bskyed// ming sbas rgyun bshags bsang gtor bya// byin rlabs mchod de so shing dang*// khyor chu srung skud ku sha sbyin// zab mo'i chos bshad rmi lam bsgo// zhes pa ltar las/

de'ang lus kyi bya ba ni/ gtsang sbra la gnas pas khrus byas te gral du 'khod nas/ rang rang gi ming yig gro ga'am shog bu la bris pa dri bzang pos bsgos pa me tog dang bcas snyim par bzung ste/ sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan por bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// bdag gzhan 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste// 'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i skabs kyi don/ tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang*/ phyi mar lha mi'i go 'phang tsam dang*/ 'khor ba spangs pa'i nyan rang tsam don du gnyer ba'i sgo nas ma yin par gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i slad du dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs la dbang blangs te dam tshig la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pa mdzod/ bsam pa de lta bu zhig skyes na tshe 'di'i nad gdon zhi ba dang*/ phyi mar lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa yang zhar byung du 'byung ba yin no// khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i slad du bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gnyis su med par bzhugs pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rnams bdag la stsal du gsol snyam pas/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo// de nas ming yig me tog dang bcas pa slob dpon la phul/

slob dpon gyis gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ tshigs su bcad par bsgrags pa 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bo'i byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// shākya seng ge'i skyob pa yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug mkhyen nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod cing de'i don ni/ de la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos te/ khyed rnams chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ theg chen la yang rgyu 'bras gnyis las/ mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje theg pa de nyid kho bos khyod la bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing*/ khyad par du yang 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing*/ 'og min du sangs rgyas zin kyang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams drang ba'i phyir du slar 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa yin pas chos kyi bur gyur pa khyed rnams sngags kyi theg pa las blo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ de nas slob ma'i ming yig rnams lhag pa'i lhar mos la sngar gyi mtshan ltas kyi bum pa me tog sil ma dang bcas pa gzhug par bya'o// de nas rgyun bshags bya ba'i phyir khyed rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum bya'o// de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de la bar chad mi 'byung bar/ bsrung ba bya ba'i phyir slob dpon gyis las sngags lan bdun brjod cing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas pas slob ma'i mgo bor spos chus bsang gtor bya/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros byung ste/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas sdig sgrib rnams sbyangs nas khyed rnams skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i skur gyur par mos pa bya/ slar yang slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes 'bru gsum brjod cing gnas gsum du dri'i thig le byas te/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po bsams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor mos pa byas te byin gyis brlabs nas ngo sprod pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas me tog dbu la phul te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes pa la sogs pas spyi ltar mchod do// gsung sgros kha cig las slob ma lhar bskyed cing gnas gsum byin rlabs dang mchod pa ma bshad pas mi mdzad ces gsungs pa yod kyang*/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ las sngags brjod cing spos chus bsang gtor dang*/ dri dang spos kyis mchod par bshad cing bla ma snga ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog phal cher du'ang snga ma de ltar du bshad pas 'thad par sems so// de nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ so shing sbyin pa ni/ las bum gyi chu dang sngags kyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo me tog gi cod paṇa dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/

las thams cad pa bzlas pas slob ma la sbyin/ des kyang*/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes brjod cing maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du tshom bu'i dbus su me tog dang bcas pa dor du gzhug de ltar byas pa'i so shing rtse mo rang ngam steng du phyogs na mchog gi dngos grub/ shar du zhi ba sogs spyi ltar brjod pa ni dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'o// de nas las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i dri'i chu lag pa g.yas par lan bdun nam gsum sbyin zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ nish+tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpāṃ a pa nā ya hūm̐/ zhes pa ni khyor chu sbyin pa'o// bar chad mi 'byung bar bsrung ba'i phyir srung skud 'dogs pa ni/ srad bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bsgril byas par rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas dam tshig gi srad bu la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ ces dang*/ las thams cad pa bzlas shing slob ma'i dpung par bcings la/ oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbān swā hā/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ dha ra ka s+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing las bum gyi chu dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis bsrung ba ni srung skud 'dogs pa'o// ku sha'i sngas stan sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i chun po che chung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha che chung rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang che ba stan gyi phyir/

lag pa g.yas g.yon du sbyin no// de nas chos zab mo bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /zhes sogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ de'i don ni/ gzhan ltar brjod pa'am yang na/ 'jig rten na u dum+bā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dang*/ byon nas chos gsungs pa dang*/ gsungs pa'i bstan pa gnas pa dang*/ bstan pa'i rjes su bdag gzhan 'jug pa yod pa rnams dkon/ de'i nang nas kyang gsang sngags kyi theg pa dang mjal ba ni shin tu dkon no// dkon pa tsam du ma zad phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang blangs te dam tshig la bsrung bsdam dang lam la 'bad par byas na brtson 'grus dang bstun pa'i bye brag gis tshe 'di'am/ bar do'am/ skye ba bdun nam/ bcu drug tshun chad du 'bras bu 'grub par gsungs pas/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu la nye zhing*/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba la sogs pa ni rtsol sgrub sogs mi dgos par/ zhar las 'byung ba'i tshul gyis 'grub pa yin/ des na rnyed par dka' la phan yon che ba'i gsang sngags kyi theg pa dang mjal ba 'di skal ba bzang ba yin snyam du shes pa'i sgo nas lam la 'bad pa dang dam tshig la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pa mdzod/ de nas rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ do nub nyal ba'i tshe sngar gyi ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du gyis la lha dang bla ma yid la dran pa'i sgo nas mgo shar ram byang du ston la nyol zhig dang*/ lung ston pa'i rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de yang rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang*/ mchod rten mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam lag tu thogs pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su zhugs pa/ rang gi bla ma dang mjal ba/ de las chos mnyan pa/ nyi zla shar ba/

rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ rta dang glang po la zhon pa la sogs pa byung na bzang ba yin pas zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba sgom zhing dga' ston bya/ gal te ngan pa yang 'byung srid de de'i ltas ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa dang*/ ka ra wī ra'i me tog rgyas pa thu ba/ mchod sdong dang bye ma dang thal phung la 'dzegs pa/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon nas kha byir phyogs te 'gro ba/ chus khyer ba/ skra bregs pa/ lus til mar gyis byug pa la sogs pa byung na cung zad ngan pa yin pas gnyid sad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med de/ don la grub pa cir yang med snyam du bden med kyi sbyang ba'i rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba dang byung ba bzlog pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya dgos pa yin no// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa rnams byin brlab/ nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs la sta gon gyi lha sang nangs par 'byon par bzhed bzhin pas rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol bar bshad pas de ltar byas na rung la/ 'di sgrub pa'i lugs dang 'brel pa'i tshe ni bar snang du mi gshegs par bzhugs su gsol ba'ang bla ma rnams kyi phyag len nas 'byung bas de ltar byas na'ang rung ba nyid do// oṃ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭhas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur ces dang*/ slar yang mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas te/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa ji srid rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ bkra shis byas te sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi'i cho ga la bzhi ste/ bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ dri ba dang rgyan dgram pa'o// dang po ni/ las thig la sogs pa sngar sta gon gyi sbyor ba'i skabs su brjod zin la/ thig tshon byin rlabs cho ga dang mthun par phyogs gcig tu byas na bde bas de'i tshul ni/ rdul tshon dmar po la hrīḥ dkar po la oṃ/ ser po la traṃ/ sngon po la hūm̐/ ljang gu la aḥbris pa dbus dang phyogs so sor bkod/ so so'i kha dog dang mthun par srad bu rnams kyang de dag gi steng du bkod/ mchod pa sbreng tshar du bsham/ slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis thig tshon rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thig skud dang rdul tshon dmar po hrīḥ de bzhin du dkar po oṃ/ ser po traṃ/ sngon po hūm̐/ thig skud dang rdul tshon ljang gu yi ge aṃḥrnams 'od 'phro bar gyur/ yi ge de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi tshon skud sa bon gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ thig tshon so so la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbarjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ yig 'bru rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi thig tshon du gyur par bsam/ oṃ te dza te dza sa ni sid+dhi sā dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang*/ las sngags bdun re tsam brjod de gzi brjid bskyed cing byin gyis brlab/ de nas/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya sogs brjod cing thig skud sgril la dris byugs te rdo rje la dkris nas las sngags kyis bsrungs la gzhag

yang las sngags bzla zhing tshon gyi yi ge rnams mtheb srin gyis mnyes te dben sar gzhag go /de nas slob dpon gyis las sngags brjod cing las bum gyi chus dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi thams cad la bsang gtor byas te/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te thig skud 'dzin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub dang*/ slob mas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa shar du bzhag ste/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod bstod byas nas/ dza dza zhes brjod de thig skud gtad cing blangs te/ sems can don du khyed rnams kun// dus yin de phyir 'dir sbyon cig /ces dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ nam mkha' dang sa gzhi gnyis ka la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du slob dpon lho nas byang du blta bas tshangs thig gnyis pa/ me nas dbang ldan du blta bas shar gyi logs thig de nyid nas bden bral du blta bas lho'i logs thig rlung nas bden bral du blta bas nub kyi logs thig de nyid nas dbang ldan du blta bas byang gi logs thig me nas rlung du blta bas zur thig dang po/ bden bral nas dbang ldan du blta bas zur thig gnyis pa gdab ste g.yas skor gyi rim pas so// de nas sngar thig skud brkyangs pa'i sar phyin nas mchod bstod byas te/ thig skud kyi ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs su gsol ba'am yang na 'og gi thig tshon gnyis ka stabs gcig tu gshegs gsol byas kyang bde'o// de nas slob dpon gyis nub sgo nas/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐/ zhes pas ye shes kyi thig bteg nas nang du zhugs te/ rang bdud rtsi 'khyil par mos te mig gnyis hi hi las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las khro bo'i rdo rjer bsams la/ khro bo'i blta bas sgo bzhir blta zhing*/ kro dha tiṣ+ṭha hrīḥzhes brjod pas/

thar pa'i sgo'i gegs bsal bar bsams la sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dri bzang gi chus dbyi'o// de nas dbus su gnas te g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis tshon blangs te/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes brjod cing dbang ldan nas nang nas rim pa bzhin du dmar sngo ljang ser dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga sgo tshad gcig gi bar du bri tshar ba dang*/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rin po che'i rtsig par gyur par bsams la nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rin po che'i snod kyis bkab la steng du rdo rje bzhag la bsrung ngo*// phyis su rtsig pa sbrel ran pa dang tshon bkra brtags te ngan na bsrung*/ bzang na spro ba bskyed do// de ltar de dag ni dkyil chog tu thig skud byin rlabs spyi ltar bya ba kha 'phangs shing*/ ye shes thig gdab tshul mdor bsdus dang*/ tshon byin rlabs bya tshul gsungs pa'i don dang*/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las kyang*/ thig tshon byin rlabs dang ye thig dang*/ dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bri ba'i tshul gsungs pa rnams phyag len las 'byung ba ltar rgyas par bris pa yin la/ yang na las sngags brjod cing bsang gtor byas te thig tshon rnams spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ngo bor mos nas/ las sngags mang du brjod nas byin rlabs ye thig dang tshon bkra brtag pa rnams bya ba ni lugs gcig go /yang na bsang gtor gyi rjes su las sngags brjod cing thig gdab pa dang*/ tshon 'gyed pa tsam bya bar rje btsun rin po che dang*/ spru lung pa kun smon sogs kyis bshad pa ltar bya'o// gang ltar yang tshon gyi kha dog ni phal cher shes pa sla la/ khyad par pad+ma'i lte bar dmar/ ze'u 'bru ljang ser/ 'dab ma nang ma phyogs bzhi phyogs tshon/ mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon/ gong ras ljang gu/ pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug mdzes tshon/ gong ras phyogs tshon/ 'khor lo byas na sngon po bya/ phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub sngo/ byang ljang*/

gzhan yang pha gu sogs spyi dang mthun par me ri'i bar rdzogs par bris nas/ lha gnas rnams su sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i so so'i phyag mtshan nam/ yang na tshon phung ngam/ thig le bri/ grwa rnams su bum pa brgyad kyang bri/ bri ba yongs su rdzogs nas tshon lhag ma la mchod bstod byas te ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar dri bzang gi chus byugs nas/ rnam rgyal bum pa shar dang*/ de'i g.yas su zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i bum pa/ g.yon du mtshan ltas kyi bum pa sngar ltar dang*/ lhor rgyas pa'i bum pa/ nub tu dbang gi bum pa/ byang du drag po'i las sgrub pa'i bum pa/ byang du las bum rnams so so'i sngags brjod cing bkod/ shar du khri'u'i steng du 'di'i gzungs bzhugs su gsol/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rnams ji ltar 'byor tshad bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas phyogs su gzungs kyi gtor ma che ba zhig cha gsum dang bcas pa bsham/ 'byor na spyi rgyud las gsungs pa ltar phyogs mtshams su rgyal mtshan brgyad/ a ga ru sogs spos bzang po'i du ba 'thul ba dang bcas pa'i spos snod brgyad kyang bsham/ sgrub pa po rnams kyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu dang*/ rol mo'i bye brag rnams dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur dang 'brel na gdong g.yogs dang*/ me tog phreng ba sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang*/ de la mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ sgrub pa po rnams gso sbyong sdom pa blang ba'am/ ma grub kyang gtsang sbra la gnas pa khrus byas te las sngags brjod cing las bum gyi chu phyogs kun du gtor te bgegs bsal/ de nas gdan la 'khod de mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bzla ba'am/ dharma ra ṇi brjod cing rol mo bya'o// de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur blta ba'i bar sngar bstan pa bzhin bya'o// de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa/ de'i lte ba sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub sngo/ byang ljang*/ lte ba dmar po'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser sngo ljang dmar ba'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la rin po che'i drwa bas spras pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i bre phul gyis bteg pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa dang dril bu g.yer kha dang*/ me long dang zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ gos kyi chun 'phyang la sogs pas mdzes pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i mda' yab dang*/ de'i steng du rin po che'i dra mig seng ma'i pu shus bskor ba'i bar rnams su rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pas mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang grwa rnams su zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje rin po ches spras pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang*/ de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres pas mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/

sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ steng du gdugs dang g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa phyi nang kun du 'od gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub sngo/ byang ljang*/ dbus dmar ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyi ma la 'dab ma bcu drug nang ma la 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan/ pad+ma nang ma'i byang gi 'dab ma nyi ma'i gdan/ gzhan phyi nang gi 'dab ma rnams su zla ba'i gdan/ de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi skur gyur pa ni/ dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes pa nas/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs nas bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi pad 'dab brgyad la shar du sgrol ma ljang gu 'dzum bag dang ldan pa g.yas thal mo gtso bo la ston pa/ g.yon ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ pad+ma la bzhengs te 'dug pa/ lhor don yod zhags pa dmar po zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu nor bzang ser po nor bu 'dzin pa/ byang du rta mgrin dmar po shin tu khros pa phyag g.yas thal mo gtso bo la ston pa/ g.yon pad+ma'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa pad+ma'i dbus su 'dug pa'o// shar lhor gzungs kyi dbang phyug dkar po pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu byams pa ser po klu shing dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ nub byang du 'jam dpal ser po g.yas ral gri g.yon ut+pa la la gnas pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/

byang shar du phyag na rdo rje ljang gu g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'am pad 'dab bcu drug pa'i shar gyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje blo gros/ ye shes mthong ba/ rdo rje'i sde/ rdo rje gsang sbed rnams dkar po g.yas rdo rje g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ lho'i bzhi la rin po che snying po/ rin po che mi btang ba/ lag na rin po che/ rin chen mthong ba rnams ser po g.yas rin po che 'bar ba/ g.yon pad+ma ser po bsnams pa'o// nub kyi bzhi la pad+ma kun du dbang*/ pad+ma sman gyi sde/ pad+ma mi 'chi ba'i blo gros/ pad+ma chos 'dzin rnams dmar po g.yas ut+pa la g.yon pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa'o// byang gi bzhi la las kyi spyan mchog las kyi byams pa/ las kyi gsang ba/ las kyi rdo rje rnams ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon pad+ma ljang gu rnams 'dzin pa'o// thams cad kyang mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa'o// de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir/ shar lhor sgeg mo dkar mo phyag gnyis dku gnyis su 'jog pa/ lho nub tu phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis phreng ba 'dzin pa/ nub byang du glu ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang bsgreng ba/ byang shar du gar ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis gar bsgyur ba mdzad pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar lhor bdug pa ma dkar mo phyag gnyis bdug spos 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu me tog ma ser mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa/ nub byang du mar me ma dmar skya mar me 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dri chab ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang shin tu sgeg cing bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa 'gyur gyi mdzes kyis mdzes pa/

lang tsho dar la babs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// shar sgor yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa/ lho sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub sgor spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rnam thos sras ser po dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang lha'i rgyan dang lha'i na bzas mdzes pa'o// de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i phyir/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa dang*/ de dang dus mnyam du sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs par bsams la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs 'tshal// ri bo gru 'dzin legs par brgyan pa nas// drang srong chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje'i mchog mnga' ba// 'khor bcas ma lus spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol gyi bar dang*/ oṃ e h+ye hi sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ru ṇi ka lo ke shwa ra ya sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod de mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid ni ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ zhes pas gdan dbul/ nyer spyod kyis mchod do// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod cing spyan drangs pa dang*/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams mdun du bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim nas dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ de nas sngar ltar gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad la 'od dpag tu med pa re res dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas gzungs ring dang snying po ci nus bzlas te brtan par bya'o// gnyis pa ni mchod pa rnams byin rlabs nas rgya cher spel nas dbul bar bya ste/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas dbul lags kyis// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra ya maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du/ sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /ces dang*/ pā d+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil dang*/ de bzhin du tshig rkang tha ma gnyis dang sngags kyi thog mtha' kun la 'gre/ chu skyes thang skyes yid byung ba'i// byang chub yan lag me tog 'di// zhes dang*/ puṣ+pes me tog lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*// a gar la sogs bdug spos 'di// zhes dang*/ dhū spes bdug spos/ mi shes mun sel sgron me dang*// rtsi dang 'bru mar mar me 'di// zhes dang*/ ā lo kes mar me/ tsan+dan ga pur la sogs pa// lhan cig skyes sbyar dri mchog 'di// zhes dang*/ gan+dhes dri/ kha dog dri ro reg bya ldan/ sna tshogs bdud rtsi'i zhal zas 'di// zhes dang*/ nai wi d+yes zhal zas/

rnga dung pi wang gling bu sogs// lha mi'i sil snyan rol mo 'di// bdag gis dad pas dbul lags kyis// shap+tas rol mo dbul lo// de nas oṃ sarba bita pū ra sogs nas/ rin chen bdun dang 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa rnams kyang gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar dbul lo// de nas bstod pa ni/ gang gi gsungs pa'i 'od zer stong 'phro ba// bdag sogs blo yi mun pa kun bsal zhing*// snying ga'i pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru rgyas mdzad pa// dam pa'i skyes mchog de la gus pas 'dud// gang zhig dad dang gus pas tshul bzhin du// bsten par nyid kyi don kun 'grub gyur cing*// srid na mnyam med bshes gnyen gcig gyur cing*// legs 'jam bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu dus gsum bla ma ltar bcas la// bdag lus dpag med zhing rdul grangs rnyed kyi// dad pas khur khyer spyi bor thal sbyar te// zhabs pad ze'u 'bru'i rtse la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal ras bcu ni pha rol phyin pa bcu// bcu gcig 'od dpag med par bzhugs pa ni// skye ba rnam bzhi sangs rgyas 'grub bo zhes// dam bca' thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po stong*// spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong*// gang la ci 'dod de la der ston pa'i// btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rjes spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bye ba bcu gcig zhal// rtsa ba'i zhal ni dkar po mdzes// ljang dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon// zhi ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// dbus ljang g.yas dmar g.yon dkar zhal// dbus dmar g.yas dkar g.yon zhal ljang*// spyan dkyus ring zhing zhal phra ba// 'dzum bcas bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// khro zhal nag po spyan gsum pa// mche gtsigs skra brjes sma ra ser// steng zhal dmar po gtsug tor can// bcu gcig zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid thugs chud thugs kar thal mo sbyar// thugs rje rgyun mi chad pa'i phreng ba can// yi dwags bkres skom sel mdzad mchog sbyin mdzad// phyag g.yas 'khor lo bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma 'dzin// ril ba spyi blugs nyon mongs dri ma 'khrud// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mda' gzhu bsnams// rnam thar brgyad ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// kun nas rgyan mang rab tu mun sel ba// gangs ri ltar dkar ri dwags pags pas mdzes// gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa 'dzum bcas bzhugs// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs pa kun 'joms rje btsun sgrol ma dang*// thugs rjes sems can 'chings mdzad don yod zhags// byang chub spyod pa mthar phyin nor bu bzang*// klu rgyal gdug pa 'dul mdzad rta mchog dpal// rgyal ba'i sras mchog phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi// thugs rjes 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang*// ma byon bde gshegs rje btsun byams pa mgon// dam chos sangs rgyas 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang*// mthu stobs gdug pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje 'dzin// sa bcu la gnas mtshams kyi sems dpa' bzhi// rgyal ba'i sras mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi// rdo rje blo gros ye shes sems dpa' dang*// rdo rje'i sde dang rdo rje gsang sbed rnams// zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi// rin chen snying po rin chen mi gtong dang*// lag na rin chen rin chen mthong ba rnams// rgyas pa'i nyams dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// nub phyogs pad+ma rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi// pad+ma kun du dbang dang sman gyi sde// pad+ma mi 'chi blo gros chos kyi sde// dbang gi nyams dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// byang phyogs las kyi rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi// las kyi spyan mchog las kyi byams pa dang*// las kyi gsang ba las kyi rdo rje rnams// las kyi nyams dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor grwa bzhi 'dzin pa'i tshul 'dzin pa// sgeg mo phreng ba glu ma gar ma dang*// spos dang me tog mar me dri chab ma// mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// bde mchog pho brang sgo bzhi srung mdzad pa// rgyal chen yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras la sogs// 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam pa rab sprul nas// rtag tu gus pas yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

rgyas par spro na dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang*/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa la sogs pas bstod par bya'o// de nas gtor ma rnams btang ste/ thog mar gzungs kyi gtor ma las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ zhu ba las gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bcud kyis gang bar gyur par bsam/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam zhing brjod pas/ bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsam/ yang gtor ma'i steng du hrīḥyig dkar por bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa phul thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byung ba gtor snod du babs pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ de nas mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal nas 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bas mnyes par bsams la/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru sogs kyi mthar lo ke shwa ra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra ba lin+ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi rje// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus dpyis 'byin pa// thugs rje chen po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// de nas cha gsum gtor ma gzhan ltar dbul/ 'on kyang bsang sbyangs gong bzhin no// gsum pa 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis/

slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar 'jug pa dang*/ dbang gi dngos gzhi rjes gnang dang bcas pa slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang rnams rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs nas bdag nus pa dang ldan par byas nas/ gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ oṃ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' chen po rdo rje dngos// spyan ras gzigs dbang bdag grub mdzod// ces brjod/ slar yang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// zhes pa nas/ kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces bden pa'i stobs lan gsum brjod/ de nas slob dpon pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ g.yas rdo rje dang spos snod/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab ste/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya bas slob ma che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la dbang bskur ba 'tshal bas de gnang zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas gnang ba byin par bsam mo// gnyis pa la gsum/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba/ dbang thob pa la rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa'o// dang po ni/ sngar sta gon byas pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas phyag btsal nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis chos nyan pa'i kun spyod gsal gdab tu bcug la/ de la rang re rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa re bya dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ kye rdo rje las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs pa ltar/

don dam par sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin na'ang*/ gnas skabs su glo bur gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs kyi bar la/ sdug bsngal gyi khor mo yug tu gyur pa'i 'khor bar skye zhing*/ 'khor ba'i skye gnas gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'ba' zhig tu spyod pa las ma 'das shing*/ sdug bsngal can gyi sems can de rnams rang re rnams kyi pha mar ma byas pa 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin pas/ de rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhes bya ba/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga logs su byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ chos snang ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba'o// de ni snying rje chen po dang smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs su snang ngo zhes gsungs pa can gyi 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus la/ dam tshig srung ba la nan tan dang lam la'ang ci nus kyi 'bad par bya'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dung pa re bskyed 'tshal/ de la sta gon du gnas pa yan chad grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la/ maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab bgegs bsal ba// gdong bcings me tog gtad dris lan// sems bskyed gsang gdams nang du gzhug /phyag dang maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab bya// ye shes dbab brtan me tog dor// gdong dbye dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul// lha ngo bstan par 'jug pa'o// zhes pa ltar don tshan bco brgyad rim pa ltar las/ thog mar slob dpon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs tha dad med par bzhugs pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dga' chen khyod bdag ston la sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i brda sprod gong ltar byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs spros pas khyed rnams dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad bsal bar mos/ zhes dang*/ las sngags brjod cing las bum gyi chus bsang gtor bya/ sngon chad dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'i brdar las sngags dang*/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bcings/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten du sngags de nyid kyis me tog gi phreng ba sbyin/ de nas rigs nges pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ zhes dris pa'i lan gdab par mos te/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags// zhes pas rigs nges par byas/ gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed pa'i ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa gsal btab nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes sems bskyed/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ brtan par bya ba ni/ su ra ti sa ma ya staṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod de brtan par byas par bsam/ de nas dung chos kyi chur rnam rgyal bum chu bsres te mna' chu sbyin pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha zhes brjod/ de ni gsang ba gdams pa'i dod yin/ de nas slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par mos/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa la phyag byas par mos te/

thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing phyag 'tshal nas/ spros pa la dga' na phyogs bzhi nas phyag bya ba dang*/ bskor ba bya ba rnams kha bskang yang legs gsungs/ gang ltar yang ye shes dbab pa'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob ma rnams dad dang gus pa chen pos shugs bskyed de/ thal mo snying gar sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma rin po che brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams dang phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams skad cig tsam gyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur pa mos/ de'i snying gar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha bye bar gyur pa'i lte ba la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa zhig tu bsam/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du'ang hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa gsal gdab/ de nas rang dang bla ma'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul nas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa mar me gcig las stong du bye ba'i tshul gyis byon nas khyed rnams kyi lus la zhugs pas byin gyis brlab par bsams la/

slob dpon gyis dril bu dkrol zhing gtso bo'i gzungs ring dang snying po'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya a a aḥ zhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod pas dbab/ gu gul gyis bdug de nas ye shes phebs pa brtan pa'i phyir/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas par mos/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor la me tog 'dor ba ni/ 'di na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang gdul bya rnams gdul ba'i phyir/ gtso 'khor gyi rnam pa can du bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ rang gi ngo bo la bzang ngan gyi rnam pa med mod/ bdag gis las bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// bdag la thugs brtses dgongs nas ni// 'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis// dman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gsung zhing sngar gyi me tog dkyil 'khor du dor du gzhug gang la bab pa'i lha'i rigs su ngo sprad/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha des khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bcing par bsams la slob dpon gyis blangs te/ pra ti gri ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la zhes pas slob ma'i mgor me tog bzhag ste/ gdong ras bsal zhing*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur bas// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// ces brjod de ma rig pa'i sgrib byed dang mig ras lhan cig tu bsal bas/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer rten brten pa thams cad mthong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas snyam du mos te dkyil 'khor la gzigs pa re mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba'i phun tshogs dngos grub kun// da lta nyid du khyod mngon gyur// dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig srungs// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// zhes pas blta bar bskul nas/

gang la blta bya'i dkyil 'khor ni/ 'di na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lha sum cu rtsa bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang phyi rol du rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba/ gur bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sogs nas de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re dang bcas pa ni rten gzhas yas khang yin la/ brten pa lha ni dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa sku dang rtsa zhal gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar zhing 'tsher ba sogs nas/ rnam thos sras ser po dbyug to 'dzin pa ste/ thams cad kyang lha'i gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang bcas pa ni brten pa lha ste mdor na lhag pa lha yi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyi bkod pa ltar mthong ngo snyam pa'i dga' spro dang ldan par bya ba ni lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa yin no// gnyis pa zhugs nas dbang bskur ba la/ yon dbul gsol gdab dbang stegs su// lhar bskyed ye shes bstim byin brlabs// gsol gdab shis brjod chu cod paṇa// dbang bskur mchod de bzlas lung sbyin// maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab phrin las dbang*// dam tshig bsgrags dang phyag mtshan gyi// rjes gnang lung bstan bya ba'o// zhes pa ltar don tshan bco brgyad las/ thog mar dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ phul nas slob ma rnams me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

slob dpon bdag la gdongs su gsol/ slob dpon thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag la bcom ldan 'das zhal bcu gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur du gsol/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba shing stan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor du dung dang rnga bo che la sogs pa mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ khyed rnams skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi par gsal gdab cing bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rnam par spyan drangs bstim/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod de byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang bskur gyi lha 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa 'dzin pa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs te nyer spyod kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang bskur gyi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon dang bcas pas bum pa thogs te shis pa brjod par bsams la/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad sngon du 'gro bas/ de rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing*/
